answer: Concrete mechanism: whisper-gated admission backed by a burn-on-fail stake. Every applicant answers a per-epoch challenge judged by peers whose seats are drawn by hashing the applicant address with the epoch beacon, so a farm cannot aim its clones at friendly graders. Passing also requires a violet bond, burned whenever the answer fails audit. A clone blast then costs real capital plus independent seals the attacker cannot steer, unrecoverable at scale. Sponsorship forces every vertex of the join graph to be vouched by a distinct aged peer, so a fresh cluster can never attest itself.
